should be got from <COL C70101FF>Arzuros</COL>.

Please.

<TALK 5><NAME 13><CHAR 5,0,11,0,1><CV 16,5>Thank you!
With this we can make the medicine.

It seems to have calmed...
Good...

This one...
is a Poogie I've had since I was small.

But lately, somehow,
its condition seems bad...

For Pecola's sake and Yuno's sake,
we must find the ritual vessel quickly!
